Asks you to update or verify KYC, PAN or Aadhaar through a message.
Claims your bank account, card or UPI will be blocked unless you act.
Link uses a cheap domain ending that is common in phishing.
Threatens a loss or penalty to rush you.
Asks for something and gives a link that is not an official site.

input: Your parcel is held, pay at bit.ly/x1

reasons.label: Says a parcel is held or undeliverable, usually to collect a fee or card details.
